title: What a 300 € Phone Really Costs With Pay Later 📱 #shorts
description:
Would you use buy now, pay later? Yes or no? And guess the real price first!

A 300 € phone over 36 monthly rates at 13.27 % effective interest a year costs about 361 €. Paying in 30 days or 3 parts is free if you pay on time, but missed payments cost fees. Since 20 Nov 2026, new German credit rules cover many pay-later deals. Example maths only. Not financial advice.

Sources: Verbraucherzentrale, Klarna price example, Stuttgarter Zeitung
